annotation.title_clean: PL n. 1539/2024 - Institui o Fundo de Incentivo ao Desenvolvimento e Inovação da Indústria de Inteligência Artificial (Fidia)
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1539/2024 - Establishing the Fund for Incentive to Development and Innovation of the Artificial Intelligence Industry (Fidia)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Carlos Henrique Gaguim)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill creating Fidia, a fund to promote AI investment, development and use and reduce regional inequalities. It defines AI systems, providers and operators, sets up a managing council under the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation, and funds the scheme through budget appropriations and a 0.25% levy on AI agents' gross operating revenue.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the Fidia fund to stimulate AI investment and development and reduce regional inequalities
Defines AI system, AI provider and AI operator
Managing Council under the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation sets priorities and publishes annual reports
Revenue from federal budget appropriations and a 0.25% contribution on AI agents' gross operating revenue
Funds AI solutions and government programmes expanding access to AI services
